summary: Authenticated frontend review covered Dashboard upcoming interviews, Tracker interview dialog/edit/empty validation, theme toggle, and all nine sidebar routes. One Settings persistence defect remains: reminder hours reverted from 25 to 24 after reload.

integration_issues.issue: Changing Interview reminders from 24 to 25 and clicking Save all settings does not persist; after reload the input returns to 24.

action_items: Include settings.interviews in the PUT /api/settings payload from Settings.jsx, then retest persistence and the notification toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: Settings.jsx renders and edits settings.interviews.reminder_hours but save() omits interviews from its request body, so UI changes are discarded by the backend.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Existing NovaMesh AI interview data was used; interview notes were updated to Technical round 2 - Google Meet and the existing scheduled datetime was preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ticket-authenticated run verified Dashboard NovaMesh upcoming card, Tracker row/dialog, empty datetime validation, interview reschedule save, theme toggle, and all nine sidebar routes. Settings save is the only failed new-feature flow; current reminder hours remained 24 after attempted change to 25.
rca of the issue: In frontend/src/pages/Settings.jsx, save() sends ai_model, email_tone, autopilot, followups, and notifications but not interviews. The local input updates settings.interviews.reminder_hours, while the PUT request drops that object; the response/reload therefore restores the prior 24-hour value.
